name: Neon
description: Neon's hosted server creates projects and branches, runs SQL and prepares migrations on a branch before they reach the main one.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.neon.tech) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
